body:
Hello Summer! Summer is officially here on the 21 st , and Healthcare Compliance Pros is heating up with some new resources for our clients. HCP is constantly adding new information to your Forms and Reference Guides. For example: This Spring we added several new documents in the forms section. These forms are all customizable and updated with the most recent relevant information. Click on the hyperlinked titles below or access your forms from the Office Level Dashboard. Here are a few of our new forms and sample documents:

  • Accident â€" Injury Investigation Form
    This form would be used to report all work related injuries, illnesses, or "near miss" events (which could have caused an injury or illness) â€" no matter how minor. This helps practice management to identify and correct hazards before they cause serious injuries. This form should be completed by employees as soon as possible and given to a supervisor for further action.
  • (Sample) Missed Appointment Letter and No Show Policy
    Use for patients who have missed appointments and also establish a no show / missed appointment policy.
  • Authorization for the Use and Disclosure of PHI
    Updated for 2015, use this form to document a patient's authorization to use and disclose their PHI.
  • BYOD Sample Policy and Agreement
    The use of mobile devices, cell phones, smart phones and tablets has become commonplace within our workplace. Healthcare providers understand that employees often utilize their personal mobile devices (Personal Devices) in the workplace. However, bringing Personal Devices into the workplace raises several health, safety and privacy concerns. This Sample BYOD Policy provides guidelines for use of personal devices in the workplace.
  • GHS Labeling Factsheet
    Labels for materials with chemical hazards are changing to a new GHS label format this summer. GHS labels will have new standard pictograms, signal words, hazard and precautionary statements, product identifiers, and supplier information. Use this GHS Labeling Factsheet to help understand new GHS Standards.

You can count on us to update and increase the compliance information you have access to on your account. Our Forms, Reference Guides and Course Library are always undergoing further development to meet our clients' needs!

On June 11 th join us for an informative webinar on using the HCP Forms, Reference Guides and Course Library. You'll receive a free Blank Module for participation in the webinar. Here's the link to the Webinar invitation at 1pm Eastern Time on June 11 th .
